description: This file defines the ApiHealthCheck class used for monitoring the health status of an API endpoint by performing an HTTP GET request and analyzing the response content to determine health status.

classes.name: ApiHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements IHealthCheck to verify the API's health by checking specific content in the response from a configured base URL.

methods.name: ApiHealthCheck
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ApiHealthCheck with a configuration providing the API base URL.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check by sending an HTTP GET request to the API endpoint and examining the response content.
